newsitem.title: UK: Wax Major demoted after election defeat.
newsitem.headline: Wax Major demoted after election defeat.

text.p: Outgoing British Prime Minister John Major had to quit centre stage at Madame Tussaud's wax museum in London on Friday within hours of being voted out of office. Major's lifesize model had held pride of place in the centre of a room full of world leaders. After his Conservative Party's landslide loss, officials at one of London's chief tourist attractions swiftly replaced him with new Labour Prime Minister Tony Blair.
Tourists queued to have their picture taken next to the wax image of Blair, Britain's youngest prime minister this century.
